label: calendar-day gaps between logged bleeding-onset dates
limitations: Synthetic summary; IDs refer to no real person or source record.
Only explicitly logged bleeding-onset records are represented; missing logs are not evidence that bleeding did not occur.
A gap between bleeding-onset dates is a calendar interval, not proof of a menstrual cycle or its biological phase.
No ovulation, fertility, pregnancy, hormone level, menopause stage, diagnosis, or future onset is inferred.
The boundary onset is the nearest logged date in supplied history; incomplete history may omit earlier events.
The boundary record is outside the selected window but remains an input requiring separate selection and authorization.
